name: claude-factory
description: The factory harness: archetype skills, agents and the policy hooks in one plugin (ADR-0049). Outside WORK_DIR the hooks waive only the cwd rule (ADR-0049): a plain session keeps the force-push, --force-with-lease, dotnet test-cap, status-word and registered-clone rules, and gets no per-task scope. Never install into a product repo (ADR-0001).
